## Description

infra/bicep/main.bicep + modules (network, appservice, sql, storage, keyvault, monitoring, defender, budgets) and parameter files for dev, staging and prod in the launch country (UAE parameter files created but not deployed unless ADR-002 says UAE). App Service (Linux, .NET 10) with VNet integration and a staging slot; Azure SQL with Entra-only auth, private endpoint, public network access disabled; Storage with private endpoint and no public blob access; Key Vault with RBAC, soft delete and purge protection; Application Insights + Log Analytics; Defender for Cloud plans; budgets and cost alerts per environment; Azure Policy denying resources outside the allowed region(s).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** `az deployment sub what-if` and a real deployment of dev succeed from CI with no manual portal steps.
- [ ] **AC2.** Azure SQL `publicNetworkAccess` is Disabled and only reachable through the private endpoint (verified by a connectivity test from outside the VNet failing).
- [ ] **AC3.** Key Vault has purge protection enabled; Storage has `allowBlobPublicAccess=false`.
- [ ] **AC4.** A budget with email alerts at 50/80/100 % exists for each environment.
- [ ] **AC5.** Azure Policy assignment denies creating resources in any region other than the configured country region(s).
- [ ] **AC6.** No secret value appears in any Bicep or parameter file.

## Notes / open questions

- Private endpoints add cost; capture the monthly estimate in the PR description (Software Architecture §9.3).
